opinions.text:
The motion to *654proceed' on typewritten papers is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is ’denied.

Charles Kimmich, pro se. Mr. Inzer B. Wyatt, Jr., for New York Clearing House Assn., and Messrs. John W. Davis and Edwin Foster Blair for William C. Potter, respondents.
